data.subject: Your FCL Quote: Rotterdam to New York, 1 x 20GP (Ceramic Tiles)
data.body:
Dear Tom de Vries,

Thank you for your quote request. Please find our offer for your shipment below.

Shipment details:
- Lane: Rotterdam -> New York
- Container: 1 x 20GP
- Commodity: ceramic tiles

All-in total: EUR 2770

The all-in total includes:
- Base freight: EUR 1800 per container
- BAF: EUR 320 per container
- THC Rotterdam: EUR 225 per container
- THC New York: EUR 290 per container
- ISPS: EUR 25 per container
- Documentation: EUR 65 per shipment
- Export customs: EUR 45 per shipment

Validity: This quote is valid through 2026-12-31.

If you would like to proceed with a booking or have any questions, please reply to this email. We will be happy to arrange the next steps.

Kind regards,

Linkport Forwarders BV
